subject.title: fix(memory-core): unify QMD multi-collection search, add phase timings, fix archived-session identity loss

question: Should QMD call-plan, phase-timing, and dropped-hit diagnostics become a supported permanent public memory-host SDK contract?
rationale: The proposed `@public` types broaden the plugin SDK and may constrain future diagnostic design; tests cannot determine whether that API should be supported long term.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Remove the new public SDK declarations and retain any needed diagnostics within the existing memory-core implementation boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the public contract
options.body: Accept the SDK expansion and require explicit compatibility documentation and focused contract coverage for the new fields.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics internal
recommendation.body: Remove the new public SDK declarations and retain any needed diagnostics within the existing memory-core implementation boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This is an API-direction decision rather than a mechanical memory-core repair.
